svg.title: WGO semantic implementation — capture, canonical knowledge, reading and recovery
svg.desc: A source-based candidate architecture with separate raw-semantic and preserved-old-history lanes. Durable sources, semantic and reader ledgers are distinguished from derived indexes and Markdown. Optional providers, resource backup, generation cutover and failure paths remain visible.
